quest.title: The Moon Adorning the Night
quest.description: The Damselette seems to have something she wants to do in the Silvermoon Hall...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: The night sky... The moons...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like she wants to play Moon Chess again. Let's play with her!

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you two.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Care for a game of chess?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Sure! I'll set up the night sky for you.

talks.objective: Play Moon Chess with The Damselette

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Perhaps... Like this?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Hmm, let me think...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Oh...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Moons... Moons...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: How about here?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Looks like I won this round.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: My three moons are connected.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Mm, this should win it.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Mm... The moons wax and wane in an endless cycle...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: It seems both sets of moons refuse to be eclipsed.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Are we... heading for a tie?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Ah, you weigh your decisions carefully before making them, I see. Take your time — we have plenty of that, after all.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Did you forget how to place your moons in the night sky? Shall I help you?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: You don't like this game? Hm... I find it quite amusing myself.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Mm? Are you staring at me? Your gaze is not subtle.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: You're staring... Is the truth of the moons written on my face?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: The board's over there, by the way...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Hm, your moons are aligned.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: The night sky is yours.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Ah... I must have... slipped up somewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You have a wonderful time playing the game with Columbina...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Thank you, I enjoyed that a lot.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: If you'd like... feel free to come keep me company again, sometime.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Here, take this as a token of our promise.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: The three moons...
